case_id_definition: Purchase Order Number (EBELN). For item-level granularity, use EBELN + EBELP.

activity_definitions.name: Create Purchase Requisition
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: New EBAN record created (ME51N or MRP)

activity_definitions.name: Release Purchase Requisition
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: CDHDR.UDATE where EBAN.FRGKZ changes to released

activity_definitions.name: Refuse Purchase Requisition
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: CDHDR.UDATE where EBAN release indicator set to rejected

activity_definitions.name: PO Approval Step
activity_definitions.trigger_condition: CDHDR.UDATE where EKKO.FRGKE changes to approved

kpis.name: Cycle Time: PO to GR
kpis.description: Time elapsed between PO creation and Goods Receipt
kpis.calculation_idea: AVG(Record Goods Receipt - Create Purchase Order Item)

kpis.name: Invoice Processing Time
kpis.description: Time from GR to Invoice Posting
kpis.calculation_idea: AVG(First Invoice Created - Record Goods Receipt)

kpis.name: Payment Lead Time
kpis.description: Time from Invoice Posting to Clearing

kpis.name: Automation Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of POs created without manual changes
kpis.calculation_idea: COUNT(POs with no Change activity) / COUNT(Total POs)

acceptance_rules: All PO items must be linked to their respective GR and Invoice documents.
Payment block events must be captured to identify invoice processing delays.
Case key must be consistent across all tables (EBELN).
